phases.name: Menstrual
phases.summary: Warm, comforting meals built around iron-rich foods, with vitamin C alongside.
phases.focusBody: Menstrual blood loss increases iron losses, so Moon Cycle highlights iron-rich foods during this phase. Vitamin C helps your body absorb iron from plant foods, so pair beans, lentils and leafy greens with citrus, berries or peppers.

phases.learnMore:
During menstruation, estrogen and progesterone are low, and the uterine lining is shed. You may feel less energetic or crave more comfort, although everyone's experience is different.

Nourishing meals, gentle movement and restful moments can offer support. A warm meal, an easy walk or simply taking time to unwind can all have a place in your day.
phases.homeFocus: As hormone levels are low and menstruation begins, you may feel drawn to a slower pace. Nourishing meals, comfortable movement and moments of rest can help you care for yourself.
phases.cooking: Slow-cooked soups, stews, porridge and warm bowls.
phases.note: These are suggestions, not rules. We feature different foods across your cycle to encourage variety — you can enjoy any food at any time.

phases.name: Follicular
phases.summary: Light, fresh, quick meals built on balanced, nutrient-dense foods.
phases.focusBody: Think colourful plates of vegetables, fruit, whole grains, beans and protein. There's no special nutrient focus in this phase, so enjoy variety.

phases.learnMore:
As follicles develop and estrogen gradually rises, some women notice renewed energy, motivation or curiosity.

Enjoy a variety of fresh and satisfying foods, explore movement that feels engaging, or make space for something new. There's no need to push yourself—follow the energy you actually have.
phases.homeFocus: As estrogen gradually rises, you may notice renewed energy or motivation. Explore fresh, satisfying foods, enjoyable movement and something new at your own pace.
phases.cooking: Light steaming, quick sautés and fresh salads.
phases.note: These are suggestions, not rules. We feature different foods across your cycle to encourage variety — you can enjoy any food at any time.

phases.name: Ovulatory
phases.summary: Fresh, crisp, colourful meals that feel light.
phases.focusBody: Salads, juicy fruit and quick-cooking proteins keep things simple. There's no special nutrient focus here either, so choose what you enjoy.

phases.learnMore:
Around ovulation, an LH surge triggers the release of an egg, and estrogen is typically high beforehand. Some women feel more sociable or energetic, while others notice little change.

Choose colorful, satisfying meals and whatever movement suits you, whether that's an energetic workout or a relaxed walk. Take moments to check in with yourself, even on busy days.

phases.cooking: Raw, chilled and lightly cooked dishes.
phases.note: These are suggestions, not rules. We feature different foods across your cycle to encourage variety — you can enjoy any food at any time.

phases.name: Luteal
phases.summary: Hearty, filling meals with protein, fibre and slower-digesting carbohydrates.
phases.focusBody: Beans, lentils, whole grains, root vegetables and good protein make satisfying plates.

phases.learnMore:
After ovulation, progesterone rises. Later in the phase, hormone levels fall if pregnancy hasn't occurred. Some women notice changes in appetite, sleep, mood or energy.

Regular, satisfying meals, flexible movement and calming rituals can help you feel cared for. You might prefer a slower pace—or feel perfectly happy maintaining your usual routine.
